# Budget

`cinnabar:extension/budget@0.1.0`

Introspection of the running callback's own execution allowance. It reads no game state
and grants no game capability, so it needs no grant.

**Grants:** None; only the current callback allowance is exposed.

## Functions

<a id="remaining-fuel"></a>

### `remaining-fuel`

```wit
remaining-fuel: func() -> u64;
```

Fuel left in the running callback, about the WebAssembly instructions it may still
execute before it traps. Mods use it to spread large work over later callbacks.
